summary: Oracle's force majeure notice on Project Jupiter shows how an AI campus can slip. This brief tracks whether that strain travels from data-center construction to chip stocks to the S&P 500.
watch: SMH closing below its 10% correction line, and Census data-center construction spending stalling or falling.

summary: The risk is a hold near 6 percent through a long-term borrow date, not a single morning print. That would raise the cost of new long-term public debt and mortgages after the spread.
